messages:
Sam (VP Eng): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands reliability segment — recording/notes here: https://redwood.zoom/rec/abc and RCA: https://docs.redwood.com/rca/2026-03-ingress-throttle. TL;DR: misconfigured autoscaler + cache TTL bug caused ~35m outage. Action items below. Please reply if you have questions.

Rohit (SRE Lead): thanks. Are the autoscaler fixes already rolled? what's the mitigation window?

Sam (VP Eng): rolled the autoscaler fix to prod at 10:15 UTC; mitigation mode enabled (manual scale to min 4 nodes) until we confirm improved tail latencies. Still watching.

Tara (Product): for customers impacted, is there a post-send comms plan? need a short blurb for CS.

Jess (Customer Ops): I can draft. Who owns the final approval? @Emilia

Emilia (CEO): endorse CS blurb; send draft here and legal will review.

Rohit (SRE Lead): note on root cause doc: timeline has a missing log snippet, I'll attach later. Also we added an automated alert for cache-TTL regressions: rule id infra:cache-ttl-regression.

Sam (VP Eng): Action items: 1) Rohit — add missing logs to RCA and verify alert by 2026-04-01 2) Priya (Runtime eng) — rollout quantized model config rollback to 2.1.4 across regions by 2026-03-29 3) Jess — customer comms draft by EOD tomorrow 4) Tara/Product — compile impacted customer list and severity buckets 5) Eng-oncall — run canary for 48h w/ enhanced telemetry.

Priya (Runtime eng): clarifying: rollback involves model config flag --enable_quant=false? ops runbook shows config at /etc/redwood/models/flags.yml

Rohit (SRE Lead): correct. We'll coordinate change window 02:00-03:00 UTC to minimize footprint.

james (eng-oncall): I'll take the 48h canary and post telemetry link once live: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ingress/canary

Sam (VP Eng): ASIDE: devs — please don't push config changes to dedicated pools without approval; we'll remind via contrib checklist.

user-bot (deploy-bot): Deploy event: rollback-config-pr-487 merged by @Priya at 2026-03-24T01:40Z

Alex (Eng Manager): FYI we're tagging this for next sprint retro. Can we get a short doc summarizing what to teach new hires about this incident?

Rohit (SRE Lead): will add a 'what went wrong' + 'how to avoid' section to onboarding docs.

Tara (Product): question on SLA credits: do we owe refunds per contract? @Marta

Marta (Finance): Initial estimate shows threshold not breached for most customers; we'll finalize after impacted list. CS should flag customers to review.

Jess (Customer Ops): Draft posted: https://docs.redwood.com/internal/cs/comms/ingress-2026-03-draft — feedback welcome.

Sam (VP Eng): please add reactions when you ack action items. I'll ping owners in ~48h for status.

Emilia (CEO): thanks all. Great visibility in the all-hands; appreciate the quick remediation. :clap:

Rohit (SRE Lead): quick note: added a short grep command to extract the TTL regression trace: 
```
kubectl logs -l app=cache -n prod | grep "ttl_override" -A3 -B1
```
Use with caution.

Jess (Customer Ops): acked :+1: 

Priya (Runtime eng): working on rollback now, will update.

Sam (VP Eng): last — please put any follow-up questions here; we'll keep this thread as the canonical Q&A for this incident.
